subject.title: perf: bound publisher profile, membership, and catalog reads

question: What permanent completeness and pagination contract should `getPublishedDisplayManifest` provide for publishers with large catalogs?
rationale: The remaining read cannot be safely optimized mechanically until maintainers decide whether callers require a complete manifest, may consume pages, can use a precomputed representation, or should accept a documented resource bound.

options.title: Adopt a bounded manifest contract
options.body: Define indexed pagination or a precomputed complete representation, preserve current visibility semantics, and track the focused implementation here or in one linked follow-up.

options.title: Document a hard resource limit
options.body: Retain a single response but explicitly cap supported catalog size and define caller behavior when a publisher exceeds that bound.

options.title: Accept the unbounded exception
options.body: Document why this low-frequency path requires a complete live catalog and explicitly exclude it from the issue’s bounded-read guarantee.

recommendation.title: Adopt a bounded manifest contract
recommendation.body: Define indexed pagination or a precomputed complete representation, preserve current visibility semantics, and track the focused implementation here or in one linked follow-up.

likelyOwner.reason: This person authored the audit, staged implementation, and explicit decision boundary for the remaining path.
